mainEntity.name: When should an accounting firm consider investing in AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accounting firm should consider investing in AEO if they are looking to future-proof their online visibility and reach clients through modern search methods. It's particularly beneficial if your firm wants to appear in featured snippets, voice search results, or gain direct answer visibility for common accounting questions. If current SEO efforts aren't yielding direct answers or your firm struggles to stand out in an increasingly conversational search landscape, AEO can provide a significant advantage by positioning your expertise front and center.
acceptedAnswer.description: An accounting firm should invest in AEO to gain visibility in featured snippets and voice search, future-proof online presence, and provide direct answers to client questions.
